          fi

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GATE-01 — approval-record checker. N/A (exit 0 + ::notice::) when
  # requirements.yaml is absent, no src/test change, or no matched record.
  # Module -> record MAP uses PRECISE paths so FR-01 evidence tests (which live
  # under test/offline/contracts/) route to FR-01-evidence, NOT FR-05-contracts.
  #   src/egta/contracts/ | src/egta/evaluation/ | test/offline/contracts/  (minus evidence) -> FR-05-contracts
  #   src/egta/evidence/  | test/offline/evidence/  | test/offline/contracts/test_evidence_contracts.py -> FR-01-evidence
  #   src/egta/risk_gate/ | test/offline/risk_gate/ -> FR-04-risk-gate
  #   src/egta/budget/ ... -> FR-02-budget
  # A single change may match several modules -> the loop checks EACH record.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  check-approval:
    name: check-approval (GATE-01)
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with: { fetch-depth: 0 }
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with: { python-version: "3.12" }
      - name: Check approval records for each changed module
        run: |
          base="${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}"
          head="${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}"
          git fetch --no-tags origin "$base" "$head" || true
          changed=$(git diff --name-only "$base" "$head")
          if [ ! -f docs/req/requirements.yaml ]; then echo "::notice::requirements.yaml absent -- N/A"; exit 0; fi
          if ! echo "$changed" | grep -qE '^(src|test)/'; then echo "::notice::no src/test change -- N/A"; exit 0; fi

          # Precise module detectors (evidence first, then contract/eval).
          hit_evidence=$(echo "$changed" | grep -E '^src/egta/evidence/|^test/offline/evidence/|^test/offline/contracts/test_evidence_contracts\.py' || true)
          hit_fr05=$(echo "$changed" | grep -E '^src/egta/contracts/|^src/egta/evaluation/|^test/offline/contracts/' | grep -v '^test/offline/contracts/test_evidence_contracts\.py' || true)
          hit_risk=$(echo "$changed" | grep -E '^src/egta/risk_gate/|^test/offline/risk_gate/' || true)
          hit_budget=$(echo "$changed" | grep -E '^src/egta/budget/' || true)

          fail=0; ran=0
          check() {
            mod="$1"; hit="$2"
            if [ -n "$hit" ]; then
              rec="docs/approvals/test-hash-${mod}.txt"
              if [ ! -f "$rec" ]; then echo "::notice::no record $rec -- N/A for $mod"; return; fi
              apbase=$(grep -E '^test_content_commit:' "$rec" | awk '{print $2}')
              echo "--- check-approval $mod (base=$apbase) ---"
              ran=$((ran+1))
              python tools/check_approval.py --repo . --record "$rec" \
                --implementation-base "$apbase" --implementation-head "$head" \
                --registry docs/req/requirements.yaml \
                --author "${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}" || fail=1
            fi
          }
          check FR-01-evidence   "$hit_evidence"
          check FR-05-contracts  "$hit_fr05"
          check FR-04-risk-gate  "$hit_risk"
          check FR-02-budget     "$hit_budget"
          if [ "$ran" -eq 0 ]; then echo "::notice::no module record matched -- N/A"; fi
          exit $fail

def _resolve(repo: Path, path: str) -> Path:
    candidate = Path(path)
    if candidate.is_absolute():
        return candidate
    return repo / candidate


def _parse_record(text: str) -> ApprovalRecord | None:
    fields: dict[str, str] = {}
    files: dict[str, str] = {}
    aggregate: str | None = None
    mode = "top"
    for raw in text.splitlines():
        line = raw.rstrip()
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            continue
        if stripped.startswith("files"):
            mode = "files"
            continue
        if stripped.startswith("aggregate_sha256"):
            mode = "aggregate"
            _, _, inline = stripped.partition(":")
            inline = inline.strip()
            if inline:
                aggregate = inline
                mode = "top"
            continue
        if mode == "files":
            match = FILE_RE.match(line)
            if match:
                files[match.group(2)] = match.group(1).lower()
                continue
            mode = "top"
        if mode == "aggregate":
            aggregate = stripped
            mode = "top"
            continue
        match = KEY_RE.match(stripped)
        if match:
            fields[match.group(1)] = match.group(2).strip()

    requirement = fields.get("requirement", "").strip()
    if not requirement:
        match = TASK_REQUIREMENT_RE.search(text)
        if match:
            requirement = match.group(1)
    record = ApprovalRecord(
        test_content_commit=fields.get("test_content_commit", "").strip(),
        reviewed_pr_head=fields.get("reviewed_pr_head", "").strip(),
        merge_commit=fields.get("merge_commit", "").strip(),
        approved_by=fields.get("approved_by", "").strip(),
        approved_at=fields.get("approved_at", "").strip(),
        requirement=requirement,
        files=files,
        aggregate=(aggregate or "").lower(),
    )

```

def _normalize(value: Any) -> Any:
    if value is None or isinstance(value, (bool, str)):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return format(value, "f")
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
            return value.isoformat()
        return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value.isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, float):
        return repr(value)
    if isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
        return [_normalize(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, (set, frozenset)):
        return sorted(_normalize(item) for item in value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        items = sorted(value.items(), key=lambda pair: str(pair[0]))
        return {str(key): _normalize(item) for key, item in items}
    if hasattr(value, "to_canonical_dict"):
        return _normalize(value.to_canonical_dict())
    raise TypeError(f"cannot canonicalize {type(value)!r}")


def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
    return json.dumps(
        _normalize(value),
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
    ).encode("utf-8")

It is\n**skipped by default** and only runs when ``EGTA_LIVE_DATA=1`` is set, because:\n\n* the offline suite and CI must stay network-free (NFR-08);\n* live availability/credentials are environment-specific, so a green default run\n  must not depend on the network.\n\nPurpose: confirm that real provider data satisfies the same evidence invariants\nmodule A enforces on fixtures (``egta.evidence`` / ``egta.evidence.hashing``):\n\n* ``published_at``/bar date is parseable and not in the future relative to \"now\";\n* ``content_hash`` equals ``sha256(excerpt)`` (integrity, FR-01/T04);\n* a real item is admissible under INV-02 for an ``as_of`` of \"now\".\n\nIt uses ``pytest.mark.skipif`` (built-in, so ``--strict-markers`` is satisfied)\nrather than a custom ``live`` marker, because ``pyproject.toml`` markers are not\nmodule A's to edit.\n\nRun locally:\n    EGTA_LIVE_DATA=1 pytest test/live/test_data_provider.py -q -rsx\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport os\nimport sys\nfrom datetime import UTC, date, datetime, timedelta\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nREPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]\nSRC_DIR = REPO_ROOT / \"src\"\nif str(SRC_DIR) not in sys.path:\n    sys.path.insert(0, str(SRC_DIR))\n\nfrom egta.evidence.pack import build_pack  # noqa: E402\nfrom egta.evidence.time_policy import is_admissible  # noqa: E402\n\n_LIVE = os.environ.get(\"EGTA_LIVE_DATA\") == \"1\"\n_live_only = pytest.mark.skipif(not _LIVE, reason=\"live provider test; set EGTA_LIVE_DATA=1\")\n\n_TICKER = os.environ.get(\"EGTA_LIVE_TICKER\", \"AAPL\")\n\n\ndef _fetch_recent_daily_bar(ticker: str) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Fetch the most recent daily OHLCV row for ``ticker`` from Yahoo Finance.\n\n    Returns fields the test needs to build an evidence item. Network + import of\n    ``yfinance`` happen only here, so importing this module offline is safe.\n    \"\"\"\n    import yfinance as yf\n\n    history = yf.Ticker(ticker).history(period=\"5d\", interval=\"1d\", auto_adjust=False)\n    if history is None or history.empty:\n        pytest.skip(f\"no daily bars returned for {ticker} (provider/network)\")\n    last_index = history.index[-1]\n    row = history.iloc[-1]\n    bar_date = last_index.date() if hasattr(last_index, \"date\") else last_index\n    return {\n        \"bar_date\": bar_date,\n        \"close\": float(row[\"Close\"]),\n        \"open\": float(row[\"Open\"]),\n        \"high\": float(row[\"High\"]),\n        \"low\": float(row[\"Low\"]),\n        \"volume\": float(row[\"Volume\"]),\n    }\n\n\ndef _evidence_item(ticker: str, bar: dict) -> dict:\n    excerpt = (\n        f\"OHLC {bar['bar_date'].isoformat()}: open {bar['open']}, high {bar['high']}, \"\n        f\"low {bar['low']}, close {bar['close']}\"\n    )\n    return {\n        \"case_local_id\": f\"live-{ticker}-{bar['bar_date'].isoformat()}\",\n        \"source_type\": \"yfinance_bar\",\n        \"source_uri\": f\"yfinance://{ticker}/{bar['bar_date'].isoformat()}\",\n        \"time_granularity\": \"date_only\",\n        \"published_at\": bar[\"bar_date\"].isoformat(),\n        \"fetched_at\": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),\n        \"excerpt\": excerpt,\n        \"content_hash\": hashlib.sha256(excerpt.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest(),\n        \"trust_label\": \"primary\",\n    }\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(scope=\"module\")\ndef live_bar():\n    return _fetch_recent_daily_bar(_TICKER)\n\n\n@_live_only\ndef test_live_bar_date_not_in_future(live_bar):\n    bar_date = live_bar[\"bar_date\"]\n    assert isinstance(bar_date, date)\n    # A daily bar dated today or earlier is fine; a future date would be lookahead.\n    assert bar_date <= datetime.now(UTC).date() + timedelta(days=1)\n\n\n@_live_only\ndef test_live_content_hash_matches_excerpt(live_bar):\n    item = _evidence_item(_TICKER, live_bar)\n    assert hashlib.sha256(item[\"excerpt\"].encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest() == item[\"content_hash\"]\n\n\n@_live_only\ndef test_live_item_admissible_under_inv02(live_bar):\n    item = _evidence_item(_TICKER, live_bar)\n    as_of = datetime.now(UTC)\n    verdict = is_admissible(\n        published_at=item[\"published_at\"],\n        time_granularity=item[\"time_granularity\"],\n        as_of=as_of,\n    )\n    # The latest completed daily bar (yesterday or earlier) must be point-in-time\n    # admissible; a same-day-in-progress bar may be excluded, which is also valid.\n    if live_bar[\"bar_date\"] < as_of.date():\n        assert verdict.admissible, verdict.reason_code\n\n\n@_live_only\ndef test_live_pack_builds_with_real_bar(live_bar):\n    from egta.contracts import RunSpec\n\n    item = _evidence_item(_TICKER, live_bar)\n    run_spec = RunSpec(\n        schema_version=\"1.0\",\n        run_id=\"run-live\",\n        ticker=_TICKER,\n        as_of=datetime.now(UTC),\n        mode=\"enhanced\",\n        model_config_hash=\"1\" * 64,\n        prompt_hash=\"2\" * 64,\n        policy_hash=\"3\" * 64,\n        snapshot_id=\"snap-live\",\n        limits={},\n    )\n    pack = build_pack(run_spec, [item])\n    # Whatever the admission outcome, the pack is well-formed and hash-bound.\n    assert pack.run_id == run_spec.run_id\n    assert len(pack.pack_hash) == 64\n    for admitted in pack.items:\n        assert hashlib.sha256(admitted.excerpt.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest() == admitted.content_hash\n",
